ev.q: The fog of the Atacama is produced by the ocean.

1.why: B段讲雾是怎么形成的：寒流使空气冷却、水汽凝结、风把雾推上山。vi The origin of the coastal mist ↔ The fog … is produced by the ocean。vii 是细节陷阱：段中说水滴很小（so small and light），但没有讲测量它们的大小。

ev.q: It consists of a large net of fine plastic mesh stretched between two poles

2.why: C段讲集雾网的构造和工作原理。ii How a simple structure traps moisture ↔ a large net … stretched between two poles … droplets strike the fibres and join together。

ev.q: for several years they supplied the village's few hundred residents with clean water. By the early 2000s, however, most of the nets had fallen into disrepair.

3.why: D段：Chungungo 项目起初成功，后来荒废。v A promising start without lasting results ↔ for several years they supplied … By the early 2000s, however … disrepair。i 是细节陷阱：段首只提到村子以前靠卡车送水，没有讲运水的成本。

ev.q: Later projects took this lesson seriously.

4.why: E段首句就点明主旨：吸取了 Chungungo 的教训（先研究当地的雾，培训当地人维修和管理）。xi Applying an earlier lesson ↔ took this lesson seriously。ix 是细节陷阱：女性参与维修和管理只是段中的一个细节，而且原文说的是 many of them women，并不是完全由女性负责。

ev.q: A beetle that lives in the Namib Desert in southern Africa collects drinking water from fog on its back

5.why: F段。x Ideas borrowed from a desert creature ↔ Engineers have also looked to nature … A beetle that lives in the Namib Desert。

ev.q: Fog collection is not a solution for everywhere.

6.why: G段先讲局限（只适用于少数地方、水量有限），最后讲好处（便宜、不用燃料）。viii Benefits and limits of the method 兼顾了两方面。iv 与原文相反：it could never supply a city。

ev.q: The droplets are so small and light that they stay floating in the air rather than falling as rain

7.why: B段。C weigh too little to come down ↔ so small and light that they stay floating … rather than falling as rain。A 错：寒流是让空气变冷（cooling），不是让水滴变暖；D 原文说风把雾往内陆推（inland），方向相反。

ev.q: were not regularly mended, and the villagers, who had not been involved in planning the system, did not regard it as their own

8.why: D段。D The community did not take care of the system ↔ were not regularly mended … the villagers … did not regard it as their own … only last if local people were prepared to look after it。B 是陷阱：卡车送水是项目开始之前的情况，文中没说后来又恢复了。

ev.q: some experimental designs have been found to gather several times as much water as the nets that were in use when the first projects began

9.why: F段末句。B produce far more water than earlier nets ↔ gather several times as much water as the nets that were in use when the first projects began。A 是甲虫背部的特征，不是新网的特征；C 文中只说甲虫生活在纳米布沙漠，没说网在那里测试。

ev.q: At the bottom they drop into a gutter, which carries the water through a pipe to a storage tank.

10.why: C段。flows down into ↔ drop into；from where it is piped away ↔ which carries the water through a pipe。不要填 storage tank：那是水的最终去处，不是水滴先落进的地方。

ev.q: were trained to repair them and to manage the supply

11.why: E段。learned how to ↔ were trained to；the collectors ↔ them（the nets）。D段的 mended 意思相同，但那是 Chungungo，而且原文形式是 mended，放进 how to ___ 语法也不对。

ev.q: It works only where there is frequent fog, high ground to catch it and a steady wind

12.why: G段。regular fog ↔ frequent fog；hills ↔ high ground。题干前两个条件已给出，空格是第三个条件 steady wind，只填 wind 也算对。

ev.q: a village system can provide enough for drinking and cooking and for growing a few vegetables

13.why: G段。meals and drinks ↔ drinking and cooking；raising some ↔ growing a few。
